product_metadata.title: Brookline Wine Glass - Premium Crystal Italian Style Hand Blown, Long Stem 17.50 oz Red and White Wine Glass Set - Ultra Thin Stem Durable Glassware - Gift for Wedding, Birthdays and Party Glasses
features: ⭐SERVICE THAT PUT US ABOVE THE REST – What’s the major issue you normally encounter while purchasing any fragile product online? Yes, you got it right – DAMAGES. No Worries!!! Brookline has got you covered! Though our package is well-wrapped and quality is top-notch, still if you find any Wine glass damaged, simply message us with the number of damaged items received along with images. You will be sent a FREE REPLACEMENT with no questions asked

✅100% LEAD FREE CRYSTAL - Unlike conventional wine glasses which contain at least 20% lead, Brookline large wine glasses are made from 100% lead free ultra-clarity crystal. All the wonderful sparkle and flair of fine crystal glass stemware, tempered for durability and carefully crafted to perfectly savor Pinot Noir, Bordeaux, Cabernet Sauvignon, or Chardonnay.

😍HAND CRAFTED STURDY DESIGN - These ultra-thin and ultra-fine lightweight wine glasses are hand-blown by an experienced master craftsman, the edges are delicately polished and cut for a thin and smooth appearance to provide a better sense of touch for your lips and enhance the quality and flavor of the wine.

👉ONE GLASS OF WINE WON’T DO IT, BUT THE RIGHT GLASS OF WINE WILL! - Whether in your home bar, kitchen, at the dining room table, for your special events, wedding, Thanksgiving. Enthusiasts, romantics, and guests will surely be impressed by these glamorous wine glasses. Impress even more and use these glasses during holidays like Christmas, New Year's Eve, and birthday celebrations. These durable wine glasses are ideal for serving wines, and enough sturdy for everyday use.

💯PROTECTED PACKAGING & OUR 100% SATISFACTION GUARANTEE - Make your purchase with confidence and rest assured your gift will get to you or your loved ones in one piece - flawless condition, safe & secure, in the extra sturdy protective foam and sleek gift box packaged to prevent breakages. NOTE: THE ULTRA FINE CRYSTAL IS HAND WASH ONLY AND MUST BE HANDLED WITH CARE TO AVOID BREAKAGE.
